svg.title: Pico 2 to PICO9918 prototype wiring
svg.desc: Direct bus and SWD wiring, shared Pico 2 USB power through a removable jumper, 40-pin ZIF socket.
svg.text: Direct bus + SWD | 40-pin ZIF | Manual power | 12 September 2026
3.3 V data writes: confirm target U5 is HCT245. Saved schematics say HC245; direct writes then need bench validation.
One USB source powers both boards through Pico 2 VBUS. GP26-GP28 are NOT 5 V tolerant; no bus wires use them.
Arrows show signal direction; data pins switch between input and output in firmware.
Align target pin 1 with socket pin 1.
* Pin 33: Pico VBUS via jumper or page-2 switch.
15.24 mm target rows; socket body not to scale.
PC USB -> Pico 2 USB; VBUS pin 40 -> removable jumper -> ZIF pin 33. Leave target USB unplugged.
Target video FFC -> existing VGA adapter -> monitor. No video signals go through the probe.
1. Configure /CSR, /CSW, MODE, MODE1 and /RST idle HIGH, then fit the target power jumper.
2. Make GP4-GP11 inputs BEFORE asserting /CSR. Release /CSR and allow bus turnaround before driving data.
3. For a manual power cycle, release bus/SWD outputs and pulls, remove the power jumper, then reconnect.
Manual option shown. Optional transistor power switch: see page 2. Use GP2/GP3, not the probe native SWD pads.
